description: This file defines a React Native component `DevMarkdownPreviewScreen` that displays a Markdown preview of a note, with functionality to copy the markdown content to the clipboard. It imports React, React Native components, and local project components and utilities, indicating its role in the application's UI layer.

methods.name: DevMarkdownPreviewScreen
methods.description: Main React component for displaying a markdown preview of a note, with copy functionality and styling.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Asynchronously copies the generated markdown content to the clipboard and shows an alert.
